headline: The Medical Receptionist Master 20
threshold: By Lesson 20, you can train a new front-desk worker and check their understanding, explain insurance and schedule problems to patients with clear options, talk through an incident or near miss without blame, answer an auditor's questions about your procedures, and write the day's front-desk report in Spanish.

lessons.title: Training a New Hire on the Check-In Flow
lessons.objective: Walk a new receptionist through check-in step by step, explain why each step matters, and have her teach it back.

words.note: Photo ID issued by Mexican consulates; follow your clinic's policy on accepted IDs.
For a man, say el compañero nuevo.

words.en: First, ask for the photo ID and the date of birth.
words.es: Primero, pide la identificación con foto y la fecha de nacimiento.
words.note: Informal tú command, coworker to coworker.

words.en: Then you scan the insurance card, front and back.
words.es: Luego escaneas la tarjeta del seguro, por el frente y el reverso.

words.en: We do it in that order because that way we avoid identity errors.
words.es: Lo hacemos en ese orden porque así evitamos errores de identidad.

words.en: That's why we never scan the card before confirming identity.
words.es: Por eso nunca escaneamos la tarjeta antes de confirmar la identidad.

words.en: Now you explain it to me, step by step.
words.es: Ahora explícamelo tú, paso por paso.
words.note: Informal.

words.en: Almost, but you forgot to confirm the date of birth first.
words.es: Casi, pero te faltó confirmar la fecha de nacimiento primero.

words.en: Good morning, may I see a photo ID, please?
words.es: Buenos días, ¿me permite una identificación con foto, por favor?
words.note: Formal, to a patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the trainer, and the AI is new hire Marisol Vega: walk her through check-in step by step with primero, luego and después, explain why each step matters with porque and por eso, then have her teach it back to you.

grammar.focus: Connectors for sequence and cause (primero, luego, porque, por eso)

examples.es: Primero confirmas la identificación y luego escaneas la tarjeta.
examples.en: First you confirm the ID and then you scan the card.

examples.es: Confirmamos la fecha de nacimiento porque hay pacientes con el mismo nombre.
examples.en: We confirm the date of birth because there are patients with the same name.

lessons.title: Why We Verify Eligibility the Day Before
lessons.objective: Explain to a new scheduler how and why insurance eligibility is checked before each visit, and check his understanding.

words.note: In pediatrics this is usually a parent; use la titular for a woman.
In insurance, a covered family member, such as a child.
Use la tutora legal for a woman.

words.en: Here we check eligibility one day before each appointment.
words.es: Aquí se verifica la elegibilidad un día antes de cada cita.

words.en: If the policy is inactive, the family gets a call.
words.es: Si la póliza está inactiva, se llama a la familia.

words.en: The card doesn't tell you if the coverage is still active.
words.es: La tarjeta no dice si la cobertura sigue vigente.

words.en: Look, these two policies ended last month.
words.es: Mira, estas dos pólizas terminaron el mes pasado.
words.note: Informal, to a coworker.

words.en: If it isn't checked beforehand, the insurer denies the claim.
words.es: Si no se verifica antes, la aseguradora niega el reclamo.

words.en: Can you explain in your own words why we check beforehand?
words.es: ¿Me explicas con tus palabras por qué se verifica antes?
words.note: Informal.

words.en: Ma'am, your son's policy shows as inactive in the system.
words.es: Señora, la póliza de su hijo aparece inactiva en el sistema.
words.note: Formal, to a parent.

words.en: Do you have a new card, or did you already renew Medicaid?
words.es: ¿Tiene usted una tarjeta nueva o ya renovó el Medicaid?
words.note: Formal.

lessons.speaking: You are the senior scheduler, and the AI is new scheduler Andrés Molina: explain how eligibility is checked with impersonal se (se verifica, se llama) and why with si + present (si la póliza está inactiva...), then have him explain it back to you.

grammar.focus: Impersonal se; si + present for general truths (se verifica el seguro; si la póliza no está activa, se llama a la familia)

examples.es: Se verifica la elegibilidad de toda la lista el día anterior.
examples.en: Eligibility for the whole list is checked the day before.

examples.es: Si la póliza está inactiva, se llama a la familia antes de la cita.
examples.en: If the policy is inactive, the family gets a call before the appointment.

lessons.title: Locking Screens and Sign-In Sheets: Privacy at the Desk
lessons.objective: Coach a float receptionist on the desk's privacy habits with clear commands, then have her repeat them back.

words.note: Usually pronounced "HEE-pah".
To log out is cerrar sesión.
Common in Mexico and the US.
Privacy principle: share only the information the task needs.

words.en: Lock it whenever you step away from the computer.
words.es: Bloquéala siempre que te alejes de la computadora.
words.note: Informal command; the pronoun refers to the screen.

words.en: Don't leave it open when someone is at the counter.
words.es: No lo dejes abierto cuando hay alguien en el mostrador.
words.note: The pronoun refers to the patient's chart.

words.en: Put them in the shredder, not in the trash.
words.es: Échalos a la trituradora, no a la basura.
words.note: Informal command; the pronoun refers to the printouts.

words.en: Cover it with a blank sheet after each patient.
words.es: Cúbrela con una hoja en blanco después de cada paciente.
words.note: Informal command; the pronoun refers to the sign-in sheet.

words.en: Pick them up from the printer as soon as they come out.
words.es: Recógelos de la impresora en cuanto salgan.

words.en: Ask the name quietly; don't say it out loud.
words.es: Pregúntale el nombre en voz baja, no lo digas en voz alta.

words.en: Sir, I'll be right with you, may I have a moment?
words.es: Señor, enseguida lo atiendo, ¿me permite un momento?
words.note: Formal, to a patient.

words.en: Now you tell me the whole routine, okay?
words.es: Ahora dime tú la rutina completa, ¿sí?
words.note: Informal.

lessons.speaking: You are the lead receptionist, and the AI is float receptionist Daniela Ortiz: coach her on the desk's privacy routine with tú commands like bloquéala, guárdalo and no lo dejes a la vista, explain why each habit matters, then have her repeat the routine back.

grammar.focus: Commands with object pronouns (bloquéala, guárdalo, no lo dejes a la vista)

examples.es: Bloquéala antes de levantarte del escritorio.
examples.en: Lock it before you get up from the desk.

examples.es: No lo dejes a la vista; ciérralo ahora.
examples.en: Don't leave it in view; close it now.

lessons.title: Reading a Colonoscopy Prep Sheet with a Patient
lessons.objective: Read the prep sheet with a patient, confirm its steps by read-back, and route clinical questions to the nurse.

words.note: Use la acompañante for a woman.
Any question about them goes to the nurse.

words.en: Mr. Ruiz, let's read the sheet together, step by step.
words.es: Señor Ruiz, vamos a leer la hoja juntos, paso a paso.
words.note: Formal.

words.en: According to the doctor's sheet, you have to drink only clear liquids.
words.es: Según la hoja del doctor, hay que tomar solo líquidos claros.

words.en: The doctor's sheet gives the exact time of each dose.
words.es: La hoja del doctor dice la hora exacta de cada dosis.
words.note: Read each time and amount from the sheet; never give one from memory.

words.en: Before coming, confirm who is going to take you home.
words.es: Antes de venir, confirme quién lo va a llevar a casa.

words.en: The sheet says you can't drive after the sedation.
words.es: La hoja dice que después de la sedación no puede manejar.

words.en: Can you tell me in your own words when the prep starts?
words.es: ¿Me puede repetir con sus palabras cuándo empieza la preparación?

words.en: The nurse will answer that for you; I'll transfer you right now.
words.es: Eso se lo contesta la enfermera; ahorita lo transfiero.
words.note: Send every clinical question to the nurse.

words.en: You need to bring your medication list on the day of the procedure.
words.es: Hay que traer la lista de sus medicamentos el día del procedimiento.

lessons.speaking: You are the receptionist, and the AI is patient Héctor Ruiz: read his colonoscopy prep sheet using antes de / después de + infinitive and hay que, say "la hoja del doctor dice..." for each time and amount, ask for a read-back, and send clinical questions to nurse Carmen Díaz.

grammar.focus: Antes de / después de + infinitive; hay que (antes de venir, hay que confirmar quién lo lleva a casa)

examples.es: Antes de venir, hay que confirmar quién lo lleva a casa.
examples.en: Before coming, you need to confirm who is taking you home.

examples.es: Después de leer la hoja, hay que llamar a la enfermera si tiene dudas.
examples.en: After reading the sheet, you need to call the nurse if you have questions.

lessons.title: Denied Claim: The Old Insurance Was Still on File
lessons.objective: Explain to a returning patient what went wrong with his insurance on file and propose ways to fix the bill.

words.note: The EOB. Many offices just say el EOB.

words.en: Mr. Salazar, I understand you're upset; let's go over it together.
words.es: Señor Salazar, entiendo su molestia; vamos a revisarlo juntos.
words.note: Formal: usted with a patient.

words.en: When you came in February, the system still had your previous insurance.
words.es: Cuando vino en febrero, el sistema todavía tenía su seguro anterior.

words.en: Your employer changed the plan in January, but it wasn't updated here.
words.es: Su empleador cambió el plan en enero, pero aquí no se actualizó.

words.en: You're right, we should have asked you if your insurance changed.
words.es: Tiene razón, debimos preguntarle si su seguro cambió.
words.note: Debimos (preterite) admits a missed step at one point in the past.

words.en: We could resend the bill to your new plan today.
words.es: Podríamos reenviar la factura a su plan nuevo hoy mismo.

words.en: We could also put the charge on hold while it's processed.
words.es: También podríamos pausar el cobro mientras se procesa.

words.en: May I have your new card to update the system?
words.es: ¿Me permite su tarjeta nueva para actualizar el sistema?

words.en: Would you have the letter from your employer with the date of the change?
words.es: ¿Tendría la carta de su empleador con la fecha del cambio?
words.note: The conditional tendría makes the request softer.

lessons.speaking: You are the receptionist at Ortopedia Central, and the AI is Ernesto Salazar, a returning patient with a denial letter: explain what happened using the preterite and imperfect (el sistema tenía, su empleador cambió) and propose fixes with podríamos.

grammar.focus: Preterite vs imperfect; conditional for the proposal (el sistema tenía el seguro anterior; podríamos reenviar la factura)

examples.es: El sistema tenía el seguro anterior cuando el doctor lo atendió.
examples.en: The system had the old insurance when the doctor saw you.

examples.es: Podríamos reenviar la factura con los datos del plan nuevo.
examples.en: We could resend the bill with the new plan's information.

lessons.title: Provider Out Sick: Rebooking a Full Morning
lessons.objective: Tell patients their doctor is out today and compare rebooking options with another provider or another day.

words.note: A man is el enfermero practicante.
The US PA. A woman is la asistente médica.

words.en: Good morning, I'm calling from San Miguel Health Center.
words.es: Buenos días, le hablo del Centro de Salud San Miguel.
words.note: Formal: le hablo is how you open a phone call to a patient.

words.en: Dr. Okafor is sick today and isn't going to see patients.
words.es: El doctor Okafor está enfermo hoy y no va a ver pacientes.

words.en: The nurse practitioner is going to see you today at 10:30.
words.es: La enfermera practicante la va a ver hoy a las 10:30.

words.en: With her you'll wait much less than with the doctor.
words.es: Con ella va a esperar mucho menos que con el doctor.

words.en: The next opening with Dr. Okafor will be in 3 weeks.
words.es: El próximo espacio con el doctor Okafor será en 3 semanas.

words.en: Which do you prefer: today with her or in 3 weeks with him?
words.es: ¿Qué prefiere: hoy con ella o en 3 semanas con él?

words.en: I'll put you on the waitlist in case there are cancellations.
words.es: La pondré en la lista de espera por si hay cancelaciones.

words.en: Hey, will you call the 8 o'clock patients?
words.es: Oye, ¿tú llamas a los pacientes de las 8?
words.note: Informal: tú with a coworker.

lessons.speaking: You are the receptionist at Centro de Salud San Miguel, and the AI is Rosa Medina, a patient whose doctor is out sick today: explain the situation and compare rebooking options using ir a, the future (será) and comparisons like antes que and tan rápido como.

grammar.focus: Future and ir a; comparisons (la enfermera practicante la va a ver antes que el doctor; es tan rápido como...)

examples.es: La enfermera practicante la va a ver antes que el doctor.
examples.en: The nurse practitioner is going to see you sooner than the doctor.

examples.es: Esperar 3 semanas no es tan rápido como venir hoy a las 10:30.
examples.en: Waiting 3 weeks isn't as quick as coming in today at 10:30.

lessons.title: Workers' Comp Walk-In with the Employer's Supervisor
lessons.objective: Check in an injured worker, keep his supervisor out of private details, and relay the claim facts accurately.

words.note: Many clinics also just say el workers' comp.
A woman is la ajustadora.

words.en: Ms. Paredes, please wait here while I check in Mr. Herrera.
words.es: Señora Paredes, por favor espere aquí mientras registro al señor Herrera.
words.note: Formal. Personal a: registro al señor Herrera.

words.en: For privacy, intake is done with the patient only.
words.es: Por privacidad, la admisión se hace solo con el paciente.

words.en: You'll receive the work status report.
words.es: Ustedes van a recibir el informe de estado laboral.

words.en: Mr. Herrera, what day and what time did you get hurt?
words.es: Señor Herrera, ¿qué día y a qué hora se lastimó?

words.en: What were you doing when you got hurt?
Let me read back the claim number: 4471-0928, correct?
words.es: Le repito el número de reclamación: 4471-0928, ¿correcto?
words.note: Read long numbers digit by digit or in pairs so nothing gets lost.

words.en: He got hurt on the 14th at 9:20 in the morning.
words.es: Se lastimó el día 14 a las 9:20 de la mañana.

words.note: Catorce and cuarenta are easy to mix up on the phone, so always confirm.

lessons.speaking: You are the receptionist at Salud Ocupacional Norte, and the AI is Gloria Paredes, the supervisor who brought in injured worker Luis Herrera: check him in privately, explain what the employer receives, and read back facts in the preterite (se lastimó el día 14 a las 9:20).

grammar.focus: Preterite narration; numbers under pressure (claim numbers, dates and times: se lastimó el día 14 a las 9:20)

examples.es: El señor Herrera se lastimó el día 14 a las 9:20 en el almacén.
examples.en: Mr. Herrera got hurt on the 14th at 9:20 in the warehouse.

examples.es: La supervisora lo trajo a la clínica a las 10:45.
examples.en: The supervisor brought him to the clinic at 10:45.

lessons.title: Saying No: A Patient Asks to Change a Work Note Date
lessons.objective: Refuse a request to backdate a work note, explain why, and offer what the clinic can properly provide.

words.note: Also called la carta médica para el trabajo.
Only the provider decides rest days; the desk never sets them.
A woman is la jefa.
Agrees with the noun: un documento falso, una nota falsa.

words.en: I'm sorry, Mr. Ferrer, I can't change the date on the note.
words.es: Lo siento, señor Ferrer, no puedo cambiar la fecha de la nota.
words.note: Formal: usted with a patient.

words.en: The note has to show the real date of your visit.
words.es: La nota tiene que decir la fecha real de su visita.

words.en: With a different date, it would be a false document, and that's fraud.
words.es: Con otra fecha, sería un documento falso, y eso es fraude.

words.en: Don't alter it yourself; the company can call to verify it.
words.es: No la altere usted; la empresa puede llamar para verificarla.
words.note: Negative usted command: no + subjunctive, with the pronoun before the verb.

words.en: I don't recommend that you turn in a note with a different date.
words.es: No le recomiendo que entregue una nota con otra fecha.

words.en: I can give you proof of today's visit.
words.es: Sí puedo darle una constancia de su visita de hoy.

words.en: I can ask the doctor whether he'll note when your symptoms started.
words.es: Puedo preguntarle al doctor si anota cuándo empezaron sus síntomas.
words.note: The provider decides what goes in the note; you only pass the request along.

words.en: I understand, but we don't do that here for anyone.
words.es: Entiendo, pero aquí no lo hacemos para nadie.

lessons.speaking: You are the receptionist at Urgencias Express, and the AI is Joaquín Ferrer, a patient seen today who wants yesterday's date on his work note: refuse politely, explain why, and offer proper options using negative commands (no la cambie) and no le recomiendo que + subjunctive.

grammar.focus: Negative commands; subjunctive after no recomiendo que (no lo cambie; no le recomiendo que lo modifique usted)

examples.es: No cambie la fecha usted mismo, por favor.
examples.en: Please don't change the date yourself.

examples.es: No le recomiendo que la modifique; la empresa puede verificarla.
examples.en: I don't recommend that you change it; the company can verify it.

lessons.title: Feedback for a Coworker Who Skips the Date of Birth
lessons.objective: Give a coworker specific, respectful feedback on skipping identity checks and agree on what you want to see.

words.note: In US offices you also hear el feedback.
Used with conocer: conocer a alguien de vista = to know someone by sight.

words.en: Tomás, do you have a minute to talk in private?
words.es: Tomás, ¿tienes un minuto para platicar en privado?
words.note: Informal: tú with a coworker. Platicar is the everyday Mexican verb for talk.

words.en: I heard you check in three patients by name only.
words.es: Te escuché registrar a tres pacientes solo por el nombre.

words.en: I know you know them by sight, but that's not enough.
words.es: Sé que los conoces de vista, pero eso no basta.

words.en: I want you to confirm the date of birth with every patient.
words.es: Quiero que confirmes la fecha de nacimiento con cada paciente.
words.note: Quiero que + subjunctive: confirmes, not confirmas.

words.en: I recommend you ask even if you know the patient.
words.es: Te recomiendo que preguntes aunque conozcas al paciente.

words.en: It's important that we all follow the same protocol.
words.es: Es importante que todos sigamos el mismo protocolo.

words.en: Your experience counts a lot, and the new people learn from you.
words.es: Tu experiencia vale mucho, y los nuevos aprenden de ti.

words.en: Could you confirm your date of birth, please?
words.es: ¿Me confirma su fecha de nacimiento, por favor?
words.note: Formal: usted with a patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the lead receptionist, and the AI is Tomás, an experienced coworker who checked in patients by name only: give him specific, respectful feedback in tú and agree on what you want to see, using quiero que confirmes and te recomiendo que preguntes.

grammar.focus: Present subjunctive after wishes and recommendations (quiero que confirmes; te recomiendo que preguntes)

examples.es: Quiero que les pidas la fecha de nacimiento a todos.
examples.en: I want you to ask everyone for their date of birth.

examples.es: Te recomiendo que revises dos identificadores antes de abrir el expediente.
examples.en: I recommend that you check two identifiers before opening the chart.

lessons.title: Two Receptionists and One Double-Booked Slot
lessons.objective: Hear both sides of a scheduling conflict, report what each person said, and settle on a fair fix.

words.note: Mexican usage: se empalmaron las citas = the appointments overlapped.

words.en: each person's side of the story

words.note: Common in Mexico and the US; Spain says la ecografía.

words.en: Yesenia, tell me what happened from your side.
words.es: Yesenia, cuéntame qué pasó desde tu lado.
words.note: Informal: tú with a coworker.

words.en: Ricardo, what did the screen show when you booked your patient?
words.es: Ricardo, ¿qué decía la pantalla cuando agendaste a tu paciente?
words.note: Informal. Imperfect decía describes the background.

words.en: Elena, do you have a moment to talk about the 10:30 slot?
words.es: Elena, ¿tiene un momento para hablar de las 10:30?
words.note: Formal: usted with the practice manager.

words.en: According to Yesenia, the screen didn't show any appointment at that time.
words.es: Según Yesenia, la pantalla no mostraba ninguna cita a esa hora.

words.en: Ricardo says his patient was already on the schedule on Monday.
words.es: Ricardo dice que su paciente ya estaba en la agenda el lunes.

words.en: Neither of them is to blame; the system failed.
words.es: Ninguno de los dos tiene la culpa; el sistema falló.

words.en: One goes in at 10:30 and the other at 10:45.
words.es: Una pasa a las 10:30 y otra a las 10:45.

words.en: Ma'am, I apologize for the wait.
words.es: Señora, le pido una disculpa por la espera.
words.note: Formal: usted with a patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the lead receptionist, and the AI is Elena Ramos, the practice manager: report what Yesenia and Ricardo each said about the 10:30 double booking with reported speech and the imperfect (dijo que el espacio estaba libre), then propose a fair fix in usted.

grammar.focus: Reported speech; imperfect for background (Yesenia dijo que el horario estaba libre cuando lo reservó)

examples.es: Yesenia dijo que no veía ninguna cita cuando reservó el espacio.
examples.en: Yesenia said she didn't see any appointment when she booked the slot.

examples.es: Ricardo me contó que el sistema estaba muy lento esa mañana.
examples.en: Ricardo told me the system was very slow that morning.

lessons.title: Keeping the Desk Going Through Flu Season Week
lessons.objective: Lead a short morning huddle that recognizes a tired team, sets commitments for the week, and keeps spirits up.

words.note: Mexican usage; you also hear el lonche in the US.

words.en: Good morning, everyone; thanks for getting here so early.
words.es: Buenos días a todos; gracias por llegar tan temprano.

words.en: I know this week has been really rough for everyone.
words.es: Sé que esta semana ha sido pesadísima para todos.

words.en: I'll cover the phones during the peak hour.
words.es: Yo cubriré los teléfonos durante la hora pico.

words.en: Paola, you'll handle the front desk and Nora the calls on hold.
words.es: Paola, tú atenderás el mostrador y Nora las llamadas en espera.
words.note: Informal: tú with teammates.

words.en: Everyone will get their full break, I promise you.
words.es: Cada quien tendrá su descanso completo, se los prometo.

words.en: Iván, thanks for telling me; we'll talk calmly today.
words.es: Iván, gracias por decírmelo; hablaremos hoy con calma.
words.note: Informal: tú with one coworker.

words.en: Together we'll get through this week.
words.es: Juntos saldremos adelante con esta semana.

words.en: We're doing great, team; it's almost Friday!
words.es: ¡Vamos bien, equipo; ya casi es viernes!

lessons.speaking: You are the front-desk lead, and the AI plays your tired team at the 7:45 huddle: thank them, set each person's commitments for the week with the future (yo cubriré, tú atenderás, saldremos adelante), and keep spirits up with ¡vamos bien!

grammar.focus: Future for commitments; encouragement register (yo cubriré los teléfonos; lo sacaremos juntos; ¡vamos bien!)

examples.es: Yo cubriré los teléfonos de 8 a 10.
examples.en: I'll cover the phones from 8 to 10.

examples.es: El viernes revisaremos juntos cómo nos fue.
examples.en: On Friday we'll go over together how it went.

lessons.title: One Schedule Change, Four Listeners
lessons.objective: Explain the same schedule change to a teen, his grandmother, the doctor and a coworker in the right register.

words.note: Short, everyday form of el otorrinolaringólogo.
El oído is the inner ear and hearing; la oreja is the outer ear.

words.en: Mateo, I moved your checkup to Thursday after school.
words.es: Mateo, te cambié la revisión al jueves después de clases.
words.note: Informal: tú with a teen patient.

words.en: Mateo, does Thursday work for you or do you have practice?
words.es: Mateo, ¿te queda bien el jueves o tienes entrenamiento?
words.note: Informal.

words.en: Doña Amparo, I'd like to explain a change to Mateo's appointment.
words.es: Doña Amparo, quisiera explicarle un cambio en la cita de Mateo.
words.note: Formal: usted. Doña + first name shows respect to an older woman.

words.en: Could you sign here to confirm the new date, please?
words.es: ¿Podría firmar aquí para confirmar la nueva fecha, por favor?
words.note: Formal.

words.en: Dr. Weiss, could you see Mateo on Thursday at 4:00?
words.es: Doctora Weiss, ¿podría ver a Mateo el jueves a las 4:00?
words.note: Formal. Personal a before Mateo.

words.en: I'd like to let you know the hearing test also moved to Thursday.
words.es: Quisiera avisarle que la audiometría también se movió al jueves.
words.note: Formal.

words.en: Fer, please update the internal note.
words.es: Fer, te pido que actualices la nota interna, porfa.
words.note: Informal: tú and porfa between coworkers.

words.en: Hey, can you help me send the grandmother a message?
words.es: Oye, ¿me ayudas a mandarle un mensaje a la abuela?
words.note: Informal.

lessons.speaking: You are the receptionist, and the AI plays Mateo, Doña Amparo, Dr. Weiss and coworker Fernanda in turn: explain the follow-up change to each, using tú with Mateo and Fernanda, usted with the others, and softeners like quisiera, ¿podría...? and te pido que.

grammar.focus: Usted / tú switching; softeners (quisiera, ¿podría...?, te pido que...)

examples.es: Doña Amparo, ¿podría traer a Mateo el jueves a las 4:00?
examples.en: Doña Amparo, could you bring Mateo on Thursday at 4:00?

examples.es: Mateo, te pido que llegues 15 minutos antes.
examples.en: Mateo, I'm asking you to arrive 15 minutes early.

lessons.title: Writing Up a Fall Near the Entrance
lessons.objective: Report a patient's fall in the lobby in order, with times, to the manager and on the incident form.

words.note: For a woman: la testigo.

words.en: Mr. Ortega, I'll tell you what I saw, in order.
words.es: Señor Ortega, le cuento lo que vi, en orden.
words.note: Formal (usted) for the manager.

words.en: At 2:10, Mrs. Álvarez slipped on the mat.
words.es: A las 2:10, la señora Álvarez se resbaló en el tapete.

words.en: At that moment, I was at the front desk checking in a patient.
words.es: En ese momento, yo estaba en el mostrador registrando a un paciente.

words.en: Then a therapy aide helped her sit down.
words.es: Después, un auxiliar de terapia la ayudó a sentarse.

words.en: I didn't see if she hit her head; I can't write that.
words.es: No vi si se golpeó la cabeza; eso no lo puedo escribir.

words.en: The mat was still wet when I checked it at 2:15.
words.es: El tapete seguía mojado cuando lo revisé a las 2:15.

words.en: On the form I'm only going to write what I saw.
words.es: En el formulario solo voy a escribir lo que vi.

words.en: Hey, did you see if there was a wet floor sign?
words.es: Oye, ¿tú viste si había letrero de piso mojado?
words.note: Informal (tú) with a coworker.

lessons.speaking: You are the receptionist, and the AI is manager Samuel Ortega: tell him what happened to Beatriz Álvarez in order, with times, using a las 2:10, en ese momento, después and mientras, and say only what you saw, not what you guess.

grammar.focus: Past narration with time markers (a las 2:10, en ese momento, después, mientras)

examples.es: A las 2:10 la paciente se resbaló; en ese momento yo estaba en el mostrador.
examples.en: At 2:10 the patient slipped; at that moment I was at the front desk.

examples.es: Después de la caída, el auxiliar se quedó con ella mientras yo llamaba al gerente.
examples.en: After the fall, the aide stayed with her while I called the manager.

lessons.title: Near Miss: Two Patients Named José Luis García
lessons.objective: Talk through a near mix-up of two patients without blame and agree on changes to the check-in routine.

words.note: Formal patient-safety term; in conversation people say casi pasa.

words.en: the patients with the same name

words.note: Ask ¿Cuál es su fecha de nacimiento? instead of reading the date to the patient.
Common word for a medical test such as an EKG or X-ray.

words.en: We almost took the wrong patient back for the EKG.
words.es: Por poco pasamos al paciente equivocado al electrocardiograma.

words.en: It almost happened because both are named José Luis García.
words.es: Casi pasa porque los dos se llaman José Luis García.

words.en: We're not here to blame anyone, but to improve.
words.es: No estamos aquí para culpar a nadie, sino para mejorar.

words.en: Rocío, you did the right thing stopping when I told you.
words.es: Rocío, hiciste bien en detenerte cuando te avisé.
words.note: Informal (tú) between coworkers.

words.en: The other patient could have received a test that wasn't his.
words.es: El otro paciente podría haber recibido un estudio que no era suyo.

words.en: If we ask for the date of birth, it won't happen again.
words.es: Si preguntamos la fecha de nacimiento, no vuelve a pasar.

words.en: If there are two identical names, we'll put an alert in the system.
words.es: Si hay dos nombres iguales, pondremos una alerta en el sistema.

words.en: Mr. García, can you tell me your date of birth, please?
words.es: Señor García, ¿me dice su fecha de nacimiento, por favor?
words.note: Formal (usted) with the patient.

lessons.speaking: You are the receptionist, and the AI is medical assistant Rocío Benítez at the team meeting: talk through the near mix-up without blame using casi, por poco and podría haber, and agree on check-in changes with si clauses like si confirmamos dos datos, no pasa.

grammar.focus: Casi, por poco, podría haber; si clauses (por poco pasamos al paciente equivocado; si confirmamos dos datos, no pasa)

examples.es: Por poco llamamos al José Luis García equivocado.
examples.en: We almost called the wrong José Luis García.

examples.es: Si confirmamos dos datos, no pasa.
examples.en: If we confirm two identifiers, it doesn't happen.

lessons.title: A Visitor Collapses in the Lobby: Calling 911
lessons.objective: Call 911, give the address and facts in short phrases, and relay the dispatcher's instructions to staff.

words.note: For a woman: la operadora del 911.
Also called el DEA (AED).

words.en: A man fell in the waiting room and isn't responding.
words.es: Un hombre se cayó en la sala de espera y no responde.

words.en: We're at Valle Verde Rural Clinic, 2240 State Highway 17.
words.es: Estamos en Clínica Rural Valle Verde, 2240 Carretera Estatal 17.

words.en: The nurse says he is breathing, but he isn't responding.
words.es: La enfermera dice que sí respira, pero no responde.

words.en: If anything changes, I'll let you know right away.
words.es: Si cambia algo, le aviso de inmediato.

words.en: Send someone to the door to meet the paramedics.
words.es: Manden a alguien a la puerta para recibir a los paramédicos.
words.note: Ustedes command to the staff.

words.en: Lidia, the dispatcher says to bring the defibrillator.
words.es: Lidia, el operador dice que traigas el desfibrilador.
words.note: Informal (tú) with a coworker.

words.en: Clear the hallway and move the chairs, please.
words.es: Despejen el pasillo y muevan las sillas, por favor.

words.en: Ma'am, the ambulance is on its way; stay here with me.
words.es: Señora, la ambulancia ya viene; quédese aquí conmigo.
words.note: Formal (usted) with the patient's wife.

lessons.speaking: You are the receptionist, and the AI is the 911 dispatcher: give the clinic's exact address, entrance and facts in short phrases, answer with si clauses like si no responde, le aviso, and relay instructions to staff with commands like manden a alguien a la puerta.

grammar.focus: Si + present → future; short phone commands (si no responde, le aviso; manden a alguien a la puerta)

examples.es: Si deja de respirar, le avisaré enseguida.
examples.en: If he stops breathing, I'll let you know right away.

examples.es: Manden a alguien a la entrada lateral y prendan las luces.
examples.en: Send someone to the side entrance and turn on the lights.

lessons.title: A Compliance Auditor Reviews the Front Desk
lessons.objective: Answer an auditor's questions formally, describing how IDs, consents and patient information are handled.

words.note: For a woman: la auditora.
Standard audit word for something the auditor flags.
Bitácora is the common Mexican word for a log.

words.en: Gladly, Mr. Fajardo; I'll show you how each patient is checked in.
words.es: Con gusto, señor Fajardo; le muestro cómo se registra a cada paciente.
words.note: Formal (usted) throughout with the auditor.

words.en: First, the patient's photo ID is verified.
words.es: Primero se verifica la identificación con foto del paciente.

words.en: Then it is scanned and saved in the electronic record.
words.es: Después se escanea y se guarda en el expediente electrónico.

words.en: The sign-in log is kept in a locked file cabinet.
words.es: La bitácora de entrada se guarda en un archivero con llave.

words.en: You're right, that form has no signature.
words.es: Tiene razón, ese formulario no tiene firma.

words.en: We'll contact the patient and document the corrective action.
words.es: Vamos a contactar al paciente y documentar la acción correctiva.

words.en: The corrective action will be documented without changing the original date.
words.es: Se documentará la acción correctiva sin alterar la fecha original.

words.en: Would you like me to send you our written procedure?
words.es: ¿Desea que le envíe nuestro procedimiento por escrito?

lessons.speaking: You are the front-desk coordinator, and the AI is auditor Roberto Fajardo from the insurer's compliance team: answer his questions formally with usted and explain how photo IDs, signed consents and the sign-in log are handled, using passive se like se escanea and se archiva.

grammar.focus: Formal register; passive se for procedures (se escanea la identificación; se archiva el consentimiento firmado)

examples.es: Se escanea la identificación y se devuelve al paciente.
examples.en: The ID is scanned and returned to the patient.

examples.es: El consentimiento firmado se archiva en el expediente electrónico.
examples.en: The signed consent is filed in the electronic record.

lessons.title: Closing Report: Copays, Gaps and a Broken Card Reader
lessons.objective: Write the end-of-day front-desk report with clear connectors: visits, payments, problems and tomorrow's plan.

words.note: Standard Mexican term for closing out the cash drawer.

words.en: Today 34 patients were seen; in addition, there were 3 no-shows.
words.es: Hoy se atendieron 34 pacientes; además, hubo 3 inasistencias.
words.note: Written register: impersonal se + verb sounds objective in reports.

words.en: At 1:00, the card reader stopped working.
words.es: A la 1:00, el lector de tarjetas dejó de funcionar.

words.en: Therefore, 6 copays were collected by check.
words.es: Por lo tanto, 6 copagos se cobraron con cheque.

words.en: It should be noted that the cash count balanced with no shortfall.
words.es: Cabe señalar que el corte de caja cuadró sin faltantes.
words.note: Cabe señalar que is written, formal; in speech say también or ojo.

words.en: The failure was already reported to tech support under number 5821.
words.es: La falla ya se reportó a soporte técnico con el número 5821.

words.en: Tomorrow we need to call the 2 patients with a pending balance.
words.es: Mañana hay que llamar a los 2 pacientes con saldo pendiente.

words.en: Victoria, I'm leaving the closing report in your email.
words.es: Victoria, le dejo el informe de cierre en su correo.
words.note: Formal usted to the office manager.

lessons.speaking: You are the receptionist at Podología Westside, and the AI is office manager Victoria Navas: present your closing report on visits, payments, the card reader and tomorrow's plan, linking ideas with además, sin embargo, por lo tanto and cabe señalar que.

grammar.focus: Written register; report connectors (además, sin embargo, por lo tanto, cabe señalar que)

examples.es: Además, se recibieron 4 pagos con cheque.
examples.en: In addition, 4 check payments were received.

examples.es: El lector sigue sin funcionar; por lo tanto, se avisará a los pacientes.
examples.en: The reader still isn't working; therefore, patients will be notified.

lessons.title: Ice Storm Closure: Texts, Calls and Voicemails
lessons.objective: Send closure texts, leave clear voicemails and handle callbacks with polite phone language.

words.en: Good afternoon, I'm writing from Northgate Allergy Clinic.
words.es: Buenas tardes, le escribo de la Clínica de Alergias Northgate.
words.note: Standard opening for a text; on the phone say le hablo de...

words.en: Because of the ice storm, the clinic will be closed today.
words.es: Por la tormenta de hielo, la clínica estará cerrada hoy.

words.en: I'm calling to reschedule your appointment; would Thursday work for you?
words.es: Le hablo para reprogramar su cita; ¿le vendría bien el jueves?
Por favor, devuélvame la llamada al 555-0142.
words.note: Say phone numbers in pairs: cinco cincuenta y cinco, cero uno, cuarenta y dos.

words.en: Would morning or afternoon suit you better?
words.es: ¿Le quedaría mejor en la mañana o en la tarde?

words.en: The nurse decides that; I'll gladly pass your question on.
words.es: Eso lo decide la enfermera; con gusto le paso su pregunta.
words.note: Never advise skipping or delaying a shot yourself; route it to the nurse.

words.en: Could you give me a number where the nurse can call you?
words.es: ¿Me podría dar un número donde la enfermera la pueda llamar?

words.en: Sorry, the call dropped; can you hear me well now?
words.es: Disculpe, se cortó la llamada; ¿me escucha bien ahora?

lessons.speaking: You are the receptionist at Clínica de Alergias Northgate, and the AI is Irene Solís, mother of a patient: tell her about the ice storm closure, offer new times with ¿le vendría bien...? and ¿le quedaría mejor...?, and answer her politely on the phone.

grammar.focus: Phone and text conventions; conditional politeness (le escribo de...; ¿le vendría bien el jueves?)

examples.es: Le escribo de la Clínica de Alergias Northgate para avisarle del cierre.
examples.en: I'm writing from Northgate Allergy Clinic to let you know about the closure.

examples.es: ¿Le vendría bien el jueves a las 9:00?
examples.en: Would Thursday at 9:00 work for you?

lessons.title: Checkout Walkthrough: Payment Plan After Surgery
lessons.objective: Walk a patient and her son through the balance, a payment plan and its conditions before they leave.

words.note: Billing term for the part insurance doesn't pay.
Common Mexican word; pago inicial is also understood.

words.en: Mrs. Ibarra, may I discuss your account in front of Diego?
words.es: Señora Ibarra, ¿me permite hablar de su cuenta frente a Diego?
words.note: Always confirm the patient's permission before discussing her account with family.

words.en: I understand, Diego; the amount is higher than the estimate.
words.es: Entiendo, Diego; el monto es más alto que la estimación.

words.en: Insurance covered this, and this part is yours to pay.
words.es: Esto lo cubrió el seguro, y esta parte le toca a usted.

words.en: According to the center's policy, you could pay in 6 installments with no interest.
words.es: Según la política del centro, podría pagar en 6 cuotas sin intereses.

words.en: If you qualify for financial assistance, the amount could go down.
words.es: Si califica para la asistencia financiera, el monto podría bajar.

words.en: As long as you turn in the proof of income, the office will review your case.
words.es: Con tal de que entregue los comprobantes, la oficina revisará su caso.
words.note: Con tal de que always takes the subjunctive (entregue).

words.en: While they review your application, the account stays on hold, according to policy.
words.es: Mientras revisan su solicitud, la cuenta queda en pausa, según la política.

words.en: How about we set the first installment for the 15th?
words.es: ¿Le parece si dejamos la primera cuota para el día 15?

lessons.speaking: You are the checkout receptionist at Centro Quirúrgico Lomas, and the AI is Diego, son of patient Carmela Ibarra: confirm her permission, explain the balance, financial assistance and a payment plan with podría and siempre que + subjunctive, citing the center's policy.

grammar.focus: Conditional; subjunctive in conditions (podría pagar en cuotas siempre que firme el acuerdo, según la política del centro)

examples.es: Podría pagar en cuotas siempre que firme el acuerdo, según la política del centro.
examples.en: You could pay in installments as long as you sign the agreement, according to the center's policy.

examples.es: Si su mamá calificara para la asistencia, el monto bajaría.
examples.en: If your mother qualified for assistance, the amount would go down.

lessons.title: Capstone: The Day the Schedule System Went Down
lessons.objective: Run a full front-desk day on paper backup: train, rebook, escalate, report an incident and close the day.

words.note: Mexican usage: capturar datos means to enter data into the system.

words.en: Óscar, while there's no system, write down each arrival by hand.
words.es: Óscar, mientras no haya sistema, anota cada llegada a mano.
words.note: Informal tú to a coworker; mientras + subjunctive for a situation that isn't over yet.

words.en: Call the afternoon patients to confirm their time.
words.es: Llamen a los pacientes de la tarde para confirmar su hora.
words.note: Plural ustedes command to the team.

words.en: Óscar, you explain to me how you'd check in a patient without the system.
words.es: Óscar, explícame tú cómo registrarías a un paciente sin sistema.

words.en: Without your mother's written permission, I can't share results.
words.es: Sin permiso por escrito de su mamá, no puedo compartir resultados.
words.note: Formal usted; say it calmly and offer the authorization form.

words.en: Sir, sit down here; the nurse is on her way.
words.es: Señor, siéntese aquí; ya viene la enfermera.

words.en: Nurse, a patient in the lobby feels dizzy; please come.
words.es: Enfermera, un paciente del vestíbulo se siente mareado; venga, por favor.

words.en: If the system isn't back before 12, we'll reschedule the afternoon.
words.es: Si el sistema no vuelve antes de las 12, reprogramaremos la tarde.

words.en: The system went down at 8:00; that's why we used paper.
words.es: El sistema se cayó a las 8:00; por eso usamos papel.

lessons.speaking: You are the lead receptionist at Centro Médico Familiar Mirador, and the AI plays new hire Óscar Tapia, patients and director Ana Lucía Prieto: run the day on paper backup, coach Óscar with tú commands, serve patients with usted, and report the day using connectors like por lo tanto.

grammar.focus: Capstone: integrating the Master 20 grammar

examples.es: Óscar, anótalo en papel hasta que vuelva el sistema.
examples.en: Óscar, write it down on paper until the system comes back.

examples.es: Cabe señalar que no se compartió ningún resultado sin autorización.
examples.en: It should be noted that no results were shared without authorization.
